title: Precommitted diagnostic donor-separability gate

source.primary_publication: Sadeghi et al. (2026), Journal of Hydrology 673, 135467
source.rule: No result from this work may be described as reproduction of the official VZAA code until the DOI-linked supplementary MATLAB is captured and provenance-checked.

scope.purpose: Test whether the published VZAA history-aware layer-centred flux relation contains a distinct and reproducible diagnostic signal relative to the current exactly conservative LayeredMFP experimental route.

sign_convention.vzaa_rule: Published flux signs are source-bound first and converted exactly once to the downward-positive evidence convention. Sign selection may not be tuned after comparison with the reference.

reference.ordinary_bottom_crosscheck: Q_N versus -result.bottom_flux; mismatch must remain visible as the accepted column residual expressed as flux.
reference.pooling_rule: FullRichards ordinary evidence and direct-Darcian stress evidence are reported as separate reference families and may not be pooled into one aggregate pass metric.

candidate.transaction_rule: Only accepted candidate steps may extend the diagnostic moisture history. Rejected trials never mutate history.

case_matrix.heterogeneous_reason: Published analytical relation is uniform-soil derived and the primary-source audit does not admit heterogeneous interfaces.

vzaa_diagnostic.history_operator: Literal published Eq. 5 midpoint-history sum as qualified by H0, evaluated from accepted candidate moisture history.
vzaa_diagnostic.c_switch: c = 0.5 for H <= 0 and c = 2.0 for H > 0, subject to final source-sign normalization.
terms: q_hist = source-normalized form of sqrt(c * D(theta)) * H
q_steady = source-normalized deep-groundwater limit of the published conductivity term
vzaa_diagnostic.hydraulic_diffusivity: MUST_BE_SOURCE_BOUND_BEFORE_EXECUTION. If the official supplement remains unavailable, any D(theta) implementation must be explicitly labelled an independent hydraulic reconstruction and its equation recorded in the result artifact.
vzaa_diagnostic.no_clipping_rule: No post-hoc clipping or singularity masking may be introduced to improve donor agreement. Hydraulic-domain failures are evidence.

characterization_metrics: fraction where VZAA diagnostic is closer to reference than LayeredMFP
sign agreement of delta_q with e_needed where numerically meaningful
delta_q/e_needed magnitude ratio where numerically meaningful
first-step, early-window and later-trajectory results separately
history length, raw history bytes and diagnostic evaluation count
NaN, singularity, hydraulic-domain and candidate acceptance failures

acceptance_policy.reason: D0 is characterization and falsification; unsupported scientific tolerances are forbidden.
reject_regime_if_refinement_robust: VZAA diagnostic is consistently less accurate than LayeredMFP midpoint flux
delta_q has the wrong direction relative to e_needed
signal direction changes unpredictably with refinement
H=0 switching creates a material unstable correction signal
useful behaviour requires FullRichards/reference moisture history
signal is confined to a regime already accurately covered by LayeredMFP and does not justify history cost
